entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *gasp* *pant*

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...How 'bout that!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa... So Ryuji had the potential too...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Even if you apologize now... I ain't[n]forgivin' you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I told you that this is my castle. It seems[n]you still don't understand...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wh— Takamaki!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wha... What a meow-velous and[n]beautiful girl...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's going on!?
Something seems off.
I'm so jealous...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, now that you mention it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But why is she even here!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now's not the time for that! Dammit...[n]Why's Takamaki here!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey! Let go of her, you perv!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: How many times must I tell you until[n]you understand?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: This is MY castle—a place in which I can[n]do whatever I want. Everyone wishes to[n]be loved by me.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: ...That is, everyone besides slow-witted[n]thieves like you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Takamaki! Say somethin'!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Calm down, Ryuji! It seems that girl isn't[n]the real one.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's the same as those slaves—a being[n]made from Kamoshida's cognition of her!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Are you jealous?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Well, I'm not surprised. Women aren't[n]drawn to problematic punks like you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Clean them up this instant!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're outnumbered... Let's scram before[n]we get surrounded!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're not gonna do anything and[n]just run!?
We can't die here.
Just shut up and go.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Thank god you've got a level head.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ngh... Fine.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We'll expose what you really are, no[n]matter what! You better be ready for us!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Hahaha! I was beginning to get bored of[n]torturing the ones here!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Come at me whenever you want, if you[n]don't care about your life! Haaaahahaha!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ignore him. Let's go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... Did one's awakening trigger the[n]other? "Personas are the strength of[n]heart," after all...
